title: Grateful Dead Live at Dean Smith Center on 1993-03-24
source: Matrix of Source 1 (shnid 109210): Recording Info: SBD -> Dat Master (48k); Transfer Info: Dat Master (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC; and Source 2 (shnid 85794): Recording info: AKG 460/CK8's > Marantz PMD-700; Transfer info: Tascam DA-30 -[S/PDIF]-> (48k) Diamond xTreme SC > Cool Edit Pro (44.1k) > CDWave > FLAC (L8)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording from the Chapel Hill shows thanks to Dan Healy's SBD patch; musical performance not detailed.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the unique SBD patch setup provided by Dan Healy, noting multiple XLR feeds and DAT decks that yielded crystal‑clear board masters for both nights. No comments on the actual playing are given, so the show’s musical quality remains unknown.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but it gives a glowing 5‑star rating focused on the recording setup and quality; with no performance feedback we weight the rating toward the excellent soundboard capture.

recording_quality.technical_notes: SBD patch provided by Dan Healy using two XLR cables (left/right), multiple DAT decks digitized off the first deck and analog connections; described as 'unbelievable' and praised for crystal‑clear board masters.
